motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the intersection of Terra Bella Street and Woodman Avenue be designated “Veterans Memorial Square” and that the Department of Transportation be directed to erect permanent ceremonial sign(s) to this effect at this location. The subtext of the sign should read “In Memory of Sgt. Adrian Carrillo, USMC”. PRESENTED BY: SECONDED BY: IMELDA PADILLA Councilmember, 6th District MAR 1 0 2026
title: Veterans Memorial Square / In Memory of Sergeant Adrian Carrillo, USMC / Terra Bella Street / Woodman Avenue / Permanent Ceremonial Signs
